ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extreme low-intensity dominance; approximately 95% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels to 5% high-intensity (white) pixels localized primarily at margins and specific linear marks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-pigmented surface across both lobes; focal high-contrast white clusters mapped to distal tips (coordinates: far left and far right edges) and sparse white punctate spots across central lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate 55-degree aperture; high-depth bounding box relative to total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with significant pixel-amplitude variations along the entire trailing margin, most aggressive at distal extremities.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve transitioning into convex outer distal margins.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white pixel clusters localized on the distal margins of both lobes, indicating heavy calcified attachments; scattered white circular pixel artifacts on the lower-right lobe quadrant.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of three distinct parallel high-intensity linear marks on the upper-mid right lobe; vertical high-intensity linear streaks visible at the fluke-peduncle junction (base of the notch).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular trailing edge notches and dense white-tip colonization on both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive circular 'ring' mark (low-intensity center, high-intensity perimeter) visible on the lower-central surface of the right lobe.
